items.title: How Trump Is Reacting to the Midterm Results
items.summary: In the days after Republicans suffered massive midterm election defeats, President Trump appeared unmoved. The New York Times’s White House correspondent Maggie Haberman explains how Trump’s public demeanor compares with what he has shared behind closed doors about voters’ frustration with some of his policies.

items.title: What to Know About the Bomb Threats Disrupting Flights in Europe
items.summary: Several planes that were targeted on Thursday landed safely, officials said, after similar threats earlier this week. The apparent hoaxes have added to airspace anxiety in the region.
